newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Kombat seen in full production in Q2 - GFN.
newsitem.headline: Kombat seen in full production in Q2 - GFN.

text.p: Gold Fields of Namibia Ltd's Kombat mine is expected to be back in full production by the end of the current quarter after a flood at the start of the year, Gold Fields of South Africa Ltd said on Thursday.
"Pumping is continuing and full production is expected at this mine before the end of the current quarter," the firm said in a statement with quarterly results.
In March Gold Fields of Namibia said Kombat would be likely to be back in full production by April.
Kombat is one of three mines operated by Gold Fields Namibia unit Tsumeb Corp Ltd.

Gold Fields said it would explore the Asis Far West resource near the Kombat mine during 1997 by more definition drilling. Exploration in the general Tsumeb and Kombat region would also be intensified.

Tsumeb's tailings plant was recommissioned in February and its performance is improving steadily, but a new lead smelter is experiencing post-commissioning problems and the refactory lining of the roof of the smelter is being replaced, the firm added.
